description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which provides a contract for logging system components to implement a method for outputting log data, possibly in a chain of log nodes. It includes a single method 'println' to handle logging of messages with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node capable of outputting log messages, possibly as part of a chain of log processors.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Intended to be implemented by classes conforming to the LogNode interface.
